description: CVEs with attested exploitation in the last N days (default 7): confirmed (CISA KEV, CISA SSVC active, or two independent catalogues) or reported (one catalogue), confirmed first. Each with severity, CVSS, EPSS, first and last exploitation evidence, KEV date, whether a patch exists, the sources, and how many indicators in our data were tagged with it this week (absent when unknown, never 0). Not in this list does not mean not exploited. Follow up with get_cve for one CVE. Costs one request of the monthly quota with a key; works without one (rate-limited by IP).

limit.description: Number of CVEs to return (default 20, max 50).
